# Repair Shop Sourcing Desk

Capability ID: findmypart-repair-shop-desk-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/capabilities/findmypart-repair-shop-desk-v1/index.html
Preferred agent route: universal fallback
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- source difficult parts for my repair shop
- parts sourcing desk
- find obsolete parts for customers
- repair shop hard part sourcing
- recurring parts research

## Problem

Technicians lose billable time hunting discontinued, cross-referenced or obscure parts.

## Inputs

Shop identity, part requests, asset/equipment context and preferred service level.

## Outputs

Recurring difficult-part sourcing with saved case memory, vendor/salvage research, compatibility evidence and resolved-case reuse.

## Pricing

Current hypothesis $99-$499/month by hunt volume/service level; not auto-quotable yet.

## Invocation and authority

Discoverable capability; recurring entitlement/payment path still being verified.

Subscription/payment requires explicit user confirmation; vendor outreach or purchases remain separately authorized.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
